A '''grease gun''' was a type of maintenance tool. One model had a nozzle to dispense [[Lubricant/Legends|lubricant]] after being warmed in a [[heating element]] attached to the side of the tool and was used to [[Oil/Legends|oil]] the joints of [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> A smaller model of grease gun with a barrel could be used to repair [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]s.<ref name="Hyperdrive" /> Another model with a longer body and barrel was used on [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]s.<ref name="Podracer" />

By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the end of [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s time living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used the grease gun made for oiling droid joints when he built his [[protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] while living on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

==Behind the scenes==
The grease gun was introduced as an accessory with the Anakin Skywalker (Tatooine) figure in [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|''Star Wars: Episode I'']] toyline,<ref name="Hasbro" /> released on [[May 3]], [[1999]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Although the grease gun does not appear in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> which premiered on [[May 19]], 1999,<ref name="Year by Year" /> the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]'', by [[Jason Fry]] and [[David West Reynolds]], identifies a prop as the grease gun&mdash;indicating it was not created solely for the toy line.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />
